description: Turn managed environments on ('Standard') or off ('Basic') for an environment and set its governance options: sharing limits, solution checker mode, maker onboarding. Changes tenant governance: requires confirm: true. Runs 'pac admin set-governance-config' with the active pac auth profile. Mutates a live environment: requires confirm: true (a dry run otherwise).

background.description: Run in the background and return a jobId immediately, for a command that takes longer than the client will wait. Poll cs_job_status.

cloudFlowsLimit.description: How many people makers may share solution cloud flows with

cloudFlowsMode.description: Sharing limit mode for solution cloud flows

confirm.description: Required to actually perform a change in a live environment. Without it the tool returns a dry run.

cwd.description: Working directory for pac (for project commands: the solution project folder)

excludeAnalysis.description: Exclude this environment from the weekly usage digest

includeInsights.description: Show insights on the admin centre home page

maxLimitUserSharing.description: How many people makers may share canvas apps with

profile.description: pac auth profile to run as: the admin account for tenant commands. Defaults to CPS_ADMIN_PROFILE for admin commands and CPS_PAC_PROFILE otherwise, then the active profile. cs_init lists the profiles.

protectionLevel.description: Standard enables managed environments, Basic disables them

solutionCheckerMode.description: Solution checker validation mode (None, Warn, Block)

name: cs_admin_set_governance_config
title: Enable or edit managed environments
